thread:
amanda: Quick weekly train digest — please read before EOD. Freezes + a small policy tweak.
amanda: TL;DR: quiet window starts 03/30 00:00 UTC -> 03/31 06:00 UTC (6h extension). Canary for model-serving v3.5 paused due to backpressure on embed-svc. Rollout budget updated to include a 5% rollback reserve per shard.
release-bot: Scheduled: release-freeze set for 2023-03-30T00:00:00Z. Canary monitors: ON. /cc @sre-oncall
jorge: Is the freeze global or just for public-hosted trains? I have a hotfix queued for infra-config.
amanda: Freeze is global across hosted + dedicated. Exceptions: emergency security patches only — must request via #release-ops and include approver from eng-leads.
jorge: Got it. For emergency path, who is the approver shard for infra? @taylor?
taylor: Yep, ping me + add the SLO risk note. Also, FYI — embed-svc backpressure came from large prefix replays after the KV-cache TTL was bumped yesterday.
sre-oncall: Incident summary: 2129-03-29 14:12 UTC — embed-svc experienced 70% CPU spikes across two pods after cache TTL change. We mitigated by reverting TTL and rebalancing prefix-cache across nodes. No customer-facing errors, but canaries saw latency bump ~180ms.
amanda: Thanks @sre-oncall. Because of that, we paused the v3.5 canary until we validate prefix-cache behavior under realistic traffic. Planning window: 24h.
mira: Any action items for platform team? I can run a focused load test if you want.
taylor: Yes please, mira. Run the small-load test with these steps:
```
# run 10k requests with prefix lengths sampled from prod distribution
./scripts/load_test.sh --service embed-svc --requests 10000 --prefix-sample prod
kubectl logs -l app=embed-svc | grep "KV_CACHE" -n
```

mira: On it, starting now. Will post results in ~30m.
jorge: One more ask — the rollback budget change (5%/shard) means we need to update our rollout manifest. Who owns that doc?
amanda: @taylor owns rollout policy doc. Taylor, please add a short migration note for engineers + a checklist to verify rollback capacity before canary starts.
taylor: Will do. I'll add the note and a checklist item: "verify free capacity >= 5% per shard" and a quick command to report current free slots.
release-bot: Canary status: v3.4 = GREEN, v3.5 = PAUSED (auto), rollout-budget = UPDATED
amanda: Final ask: if anyone has queued non-critical merges, hold them until freeze lifts. Emergency exceptions only. I'll post a brief follow-up with exact exception request format.
jorge: 👍 thanks.
mira: Load results: 10k requests completed, KV_CACHE eviction rate returned to baseline after TTL revert. Attaching small summary in the #eng-releases thread.
amanda: Great work team. We'll reconvene if anything changes; otherwise assume freeze start/time and the 6h extension are final. :wave:
